description: CM Shivakumar envisions an “AI-native state” where artificial intelligence powers governance, education, industry and public services. At the heart of the vision is India’s first government-driven AI University, with a 100-acre Bengaluru campus and regional centres across Karnataka.
body_lead: Karnataka is moving beyond simply adopting artificial intelligence to boost its $153 billion startup revolution. The state recently began building an AI-driven governance and economic model where technology improves transparency, reduces fraud, creates skilled employment and strengthens the already powerful startup ecosystem. Chief Minister DK Shivakumar also met with senior officials from Anthropic to discuss “potential areas of collaboration”.
